title: JMAP Email date filter uses lexicographic string comparison (broken for fractional seconds)
description: mail/email/query.rs:36-39: e.date.as_str() >= after uses lexicographic comparison on RFC 3339 strings. '2026-04-01T10:00:00.100Z' < '2026-04-01T10:00:00Z' lexicographically but is chronologically later. A filter after: '2026-04-01T10:00:00Z' would incorrectly exclude messages at 10:00:00.100Z. Fix: parse both strings to DateTime<Utc> and compare as integers.
